language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language for the app interface. Content generated by AI keeps its own language.

general.automationSubtitleOn: Omi can click and type in your apps when you ask.
general.automationSubtitleOff: Turn on to let Omi act in your apps when you ask.
general.screenAnalysisSubtitle: Master switch for Omi's proactive screen features — Focus, memory and task extraction, and insights. When off, Omi never analyzes your screen. Separate from Screen Capture above, which only records your local Rewind timeline.
general.chatHistorySubtitle: By default, one ongoing conversation (shared with the floating bar) that persists across launches — scroll up in chat to load older messages. Or start a fresh conversation each launch.
general.multiChatSubtitleOff: Single chat synced with the mobile app
general.legacyHomeSubtitle: The redesigned Home — one stage with your stats, an ask bar, and suggestions. Turn this off to go back to the previous Home.
general.meetingDetectionSubtitle: When a meeting app is holding the microphone (Zoom, Teams, Meet, and more), Omi can capture and transcribe it — always with a visible notice, never silently.
general.launchAtLoginSubtitle: Start Omi automatically when you sign in to Windows.
general.launchAtLoginSubtitleUninstalled: Start Omi automatically when you sign in to Windows. Available in installed builds only.
general.fontSizePreview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

agents.intro: Ask for an agent by name in chat or push-to-talk — “ask Codex to fix the failing test”, “use Claude Code to add a readme” — and Omi hands the task over, streaming the agent’s progress into the conversation. If the agent you named is down, Omi falls back to the next connected one.
agents.claudeSubtitleConnected: Built in — signed in with your Claude account.
agents.claudeSubtitleDisconnected: Built in — no install needed. Sign in with your Claude account to use it.
agents.signInNote: Finish signing in in your browser, then come back here.
agents.connectedHandshake: Connected — the agent answered the handshake.
agents.openclawDescription: Open-source AI coding assistant with its own gateway and model routing.
agents.hermesDescription: Nous Research's Hermes agent, connected over its ACP server mode.
agents.codexDescription: OpenAI's Codex agent, driven through the official codex-acp bridge.
agents.openclawAuthNote: After installing, sign in: run `openclaw onboard` in a terminal.
agents.hermesAuthNote: After installing, sign in: run `hermes login` in a terminal.
agents.codexAuthNote: Sign in with `codex login`, or add your OpenAI API key below.
agents.hermesInstallNote: Install the Hermes CLI from its documentation.
agents.apiKeySaved: A key is saved — Codex will use it to authenticate.
agents.apiKeyPrompt: Paste your OpenAI API key and we'll validate it — no browser sign-in needed.

transcription.languageModeSubtitle: How Omi transcribes what you say. Applies to your next recording session.
transcription.autoDetectSubtitle: Detects and transcribes several languages at once — best when you switch languages.
transcription.singleLanguageSubtitle: Best when you speak one language. Pick it below.
transcription.vadSubtitle: On-device voice-activity detection skips silence before it reaches transcription, reducing usage and cost. Turn off to send all captured audio.

rewind.continuousSubtitle: Always-on microphone. Omi turns what you hear into conversations automatically.
rewind.autoCleanupSubtitle: Remove empty conversations and junk memories. Preview logs what it would delete; switch to Delete to apply.
rewind.captureSubtitle: A local, searchable timeline stored only on this PC — never uploaded.
rewind.intervalSubtitle: How often a frame is sampled.
rewind.qualitySubtitle: Higher quality makes small on-screen text readable (better search and OCR), and uses more CPU and disk.
rewind.excludedSubtitle: Rewind never screenshots while one of these apps is in focus. Matched loosely (e.g. “chrome” covers Google Chrome).
rewind.excludedNote: Login, password, and private-browsing screens are skipped automatically (by window title).
rewind.screenMemoriesSubtitle: Turns recent on-screen text (from Rewind) into memories. On-device redaction first; skips private/incognito windows. Off by default — writes to your Omi account.
rewind.denylistPlaceholder: Denylist — one app/site keyword per line (e.g. therapy, salary)
rewind.insightsSubtitle: Periodically reviews recent screen activity and surfaces a single useful insight (choose the style below). Requires screen capture, and Notifications turned on with a frequency above Off.
rewind.insightsSilenced: Notifications are off, so insights never run — a test notification still shows because it bypasses this. Turn Notifications on and raise the frequency above Off in Settings → Notifications.
rewind.goalsSubtitle: Occasionally reviews your memories, conversations, and tasks on-device and creates a goal it thinks fits you. Off by default; you can always use Suggest on the Goals page.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Control how often Omi's proactive assistants can notify you.
notifications.frequencyOffNote: Proactive notifications are off. Raise the frequency to let Omi notify you.
notifications.focusSubtitle: Show a notification on focus changes.
notifications.focusNote: Turning this off also pauses focus analysis entirely.
notifications.memoriesSubtitle: Periodically looks at your screen and saves useful facts to your Omi memories. Runs quietly — no notifications. Requires Screen Analysis (Settings → General).
notifications.glowSubtitle: Draw a colored ring around the active window when Focus detects a distraction or a refocus.
notifications.insightsSubtitle: Proactive insights are configured in Settings → Rewind.

privacy.trackingSubtitle: Records which apps you actively use (app name only, never window titles) — locally — to improve memory ranking.
privacy.hideBarTitle: Hide the Omi bar from screen sharing
privacy.hideBarSubtitle: Excludes the top-edge bar from screenshots, recordings, and shared screens. Turn off if you want it visible in captures.
privacy.screenShareSubtitle: Let Omi capture your screen when you ask about what's on it. Omi only captures when you ask — turning this on doesn't share anything on its own.
privacy.onDeviceSubtitle: Your screen timeline, file index, and app usage stay on this PC. Only synthesized facts (memories) are sent to your Omi account, and only for features you turn on.

planUsage.planRetiringFallback: Your Unlimited plan is being retired. Try the new Operator plan — same great features at $49/mo.
planUsage.overageBodyNoOverage: Go over your {{included}} included questions and we'll charge real provider cost + {{percent}}%. No hard cutoff.
planUsage.overageBodyOverage: You've gone {{excess}} question{{plural}} past your plan's {{included}} included. We'll bill the overage at the end of your cycle.
planUsage.choosePlanSubtitle: Pick one plan first. Billing options appear only after the card is selected.

shortcuts.summonSubtitle: Global shortcut to reveal the floating bar and ask a question.
shortcuts.recordSubtitle: Global shortcut to start and stop recording.
shortcuts.heldByOther: This shortcut is held by another app — pick a different one.
shortcuts.alreadyInUse: That shortcut is already in use — try another.

advanced.importSubtitle: Paste a ChatGPT/Claude “everything you remember about me” reply; Omi extracts distinct, durable facts.
advanced.pastePlaceholder: Paste the assistant’s full reply here…
advanced.exportSubtitle: Export your {{count}} memor{{plural}} as Markdown (Obsidian, a plain file, or Notion).
advanced.notionHelp: Notion — paste an internal-integration token and a page ID it can access.
advanced.notionMissing: Enter your Notion token and parent page ID
advanced.maintenanceSubtitle: Find and remove legacy app/file-index memories (these belong in the knowledge graph, not memories). Analyze is read-only.
advanced.integrationsStickySubtitle: Reads your Sticky Notes locally and saves durable facts as memories. Your notes are never uploaded — only the synthesized facts.
advanced.googleSubtitleDisconnected: Turn recent email (subject/sender only) into memories and upcoming events into tasks.
advanced.gmailConnectedSubtitle: Connected — reads recent mail through your signed-in Google session. No OAuth scopes; sign-in stays inside Omi.
advanced.gmailDisconnectedSubtitle: Sign into Google once inside Omi, then read recent mail without restricted-scope OAuth.
advanced.aiProfileSubtitle: A synthesized “about you” summary Omi builds from your memories, tasks, goals, and conversations — used to personalize proactive help.
advanced.aiProfileGenerateFailed: Couldn't generate a profile right now. Make sure you're signed in and try again.
advanced.aiProfileSaveFailed: Couldn't save your changes. Try again.
advanced.aiProfileDeleteFailed: Couldn't delete the profile. Try again.
advanced.devKeysActiveSubtitle: You're paying your own providers. Omi skips the subscription charge. Keys stay on this PC.
advanced.devKeysInactiveSubtitle: Provide all four keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Deepgram) to switch to the free plan. Keys stay on this PC — we never store them on our servers.
advanced.devKeysUnreachable: Couldn't reach Omi to switch on the free plan. Try again.
advanced.devKeysRejected: Rejected by provider: {{providers}}. Free plan stays off until all 4 keys authenticate.
advanced.devKeysGeminiSubtitle: For proactive AI (memory, tasks, insights, focus).
advanced.fileIndexSubtitle: Indexes file names/metadata locally (contents never read or uploaded).
advanced.kgSubtitle: A local graph of your projects, tech, people, and apps — used to ground chat answers.
advanced.onboardingSubtitle: Run the startup wizard again from the beginning.
advanced.noStickyFound: No Sticky Notes found on this PC
advanced.stickyNoNew: No new memories found in your notes

about.title: Omi for Windows
about.linksSubtitle: Learn more about Omi, get help, and read the terms.
about.softwareSubtitle: Omi updates itself in the background and installs the next time you restart.
about.betaSubtitle: Get pre-release versions early. Beta builds get new features first but may be less stable. Turn off to stay on stable releases.
about.updateReadySubtitle: Version {{version}} is ready. Restart Omi to apply it.
about.updateUnsupported: Updates install automatically. You're on version {{version}}.
about.updateAvailable: Update available{{version}} — downloading in the background. Omi will offer to restart once it's ready.
about.updateNoLongerStaged: That update is no longer staged. Omi will offer to restart once it downloads again.
